description: CRASH-NEW and CRASH-CONTROL, and EX-CREATE against a creator stopped inside CreateDatabase. Process a signals and calls DBEngine.CreateDatabase of scratch-frozen.accdb; b suspends a 200 ms after the signal (a had not returned: 50 ms Await), lists and keeps the files and their bytes, tries OpenDatabase read-only and shared (Errors before/after), CreateDatabase of the same path (Errors) and a native read share-read open, then resumes a and, after a pause, opens the finished file and reads Version and TableDefs (independent final read). Asks what exists on disk while creation is stopped, how a second opener and a second creator are answered, and whether the resumed creation completes.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
